=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- changelog.d/8217-release-gate-capacity-wait.md:2 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The lead sentence says a clarify, plan, implement or orchestrate run labels its item `ai:claude-capacity-wait`, but an orchestrate pause has no item to label.
  WHY: Operators reading the changelog would look for a label that is never applied; the sentence is documentation wording only. Reviewers rated it NIT. Cited evidence: orchestrate.yml:898-905 and tests/test_ai_engine.py:1476-1481.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:5060-5080 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The alt-model wait checks `ai:claude-capacity-wait` before its success branch, unlike the clarify/plan/implement waits (lines 998, 1227, 1602), which check it after.
  WHY: A run that reached `ai:done` while still labeled would be reported as `claude_capacity`; the gate fails either way, so the only effect is misattribution. Rated NIT.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:4480 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The jobs listing uses `2>/dev/null || true`, so a failed listing produces no warning, unlike the log-fetch path at lines 4493-4495.
  WHY: The operator gets no signal that the per-job log scan was skipped. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #8217 item 4, "Optional but recommended: add one preflight step in the E2E jobs (or `resolve-version`)" that stops the gate when an open trusted `kind=capacity` tracker exists.
  expected_change_site: A preflight step in `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`, either in `resolve-version` or at the start of the E2E jobs.
  confidence=1
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  EVIDENCE: No hunk adds a preflight step. The issue marks it optional, and the in-loop checks already fail the gate within one poll, or after the orchestrate step's 90-second search.
- requirement: "In the results step, show `claude_capacity` as its own reason (for example `✗ Clarify .... FAILED (claude_capacity)`)" (issue #8217, Suggested fix item 1) and "Alt-model wait loop: add `ai:claude-capacity-wait` to the fail-fast checks, with the same message and status" (item 2).
  expected_change_site: A consumer of `status=claude_capacity` for `e2e-alt-model-test` (wait step around lines 5049-5088) and `orchestrate-decompose-test` (dispatch step around lines 4381-4513), such as the results summary rows (around 3385-3550) or the notify reads (around 6422-6425, 6518-6527).
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The diff writes `status=claude_capacity` to `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` only (lines 4508-4509 and 5062-5063). No `steps.dispatch.outputs.status` or `steps.wait.outputs.status` reference exists, the summary table has no row for either job, and notify reads only `needs.<job>.result`. The changelog discloses the alt-model case but not the orchestrate-decompose case.
